tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Brand navy (reference). Surface inverse, hero panels and footer on navy. Never body text.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Dark panels and the navy inverse surface (surface-inverse-alt); hover of action-secondary.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: Brand cyan, artwork only (logo and gradients). It is not an action, focus or link colour.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Paper, the page background (reference).

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Brand gray. Muted text on surface-page and surface-card (text-muted).

tokens.name: brand-gray-600
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Muted text on light surfaces (text-muted): 5:1 or better on page, card, sunken and raised.

tokens.name: brand-navy-600
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Hover states and hairlines on navy.

tokens.name: brand-navy-400
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Hover states and hairlines on navy.

tokens.name: brand-cyan-600
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Primary pressed fill (action-primary-active) and info marks. Below 4.5:1 as text on white: use brand-cyan-700 for text.

tokens.name: brand-cyan-700
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Accent text and links on white and light surfaces (text-accent, link): 5:1 or better on surface-card, surface-page and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand-cyan-300
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Primary hover on brand-dark-text buttons (action-primary-hover).

tokens.name: brand-cyan-100
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Tinted accent fill (surface-accent-subtle).

tokens.name: brand-gray-400
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Muted text on surface-inverse (text-on-inverse-muted).

tokens.name: brand-gray-500
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Form-control borders on light surfaces (border-control), 3:1 against surface-card.

tokens.name: brand-gray-200
tokens.usage: Derived step, not a brand colour. Strong borders on surface-card and surface-page (border-strong).

tokens.name: brand-gray-100
tokens.usage: Hairline line of the reference.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Cards (surface-card) and text on surface-inverse (text-on-inverse).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Body copy: text-body and text-heading on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Card background. Body copy text-body and text-muted on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search field and metric cells (reference surface).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles, hover fills, chips and neutral icon tiles that must stand out from page, card and sunken. Visible step in both themes (darker than card in light, lighter than card in dark). text-body and text-muted pass on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Deepest surface: hero overlays, footer, toasts. Text-on-inverse and text-on-inverse-muted on it. In the dark theme it is darker than surface-page so panels still read.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-alt
tokens.usage: Second dark surface, for panels inside a dark view. Text-on-inverse on it.

tokens.name: surface-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Accent background, teal claro in light mode.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop of the reference, with blur-panel.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Helper and secondary copy. Reference #788496 measures 3.8:1 on white; this one measures 5.4:1 (decision D3, to report).

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text on surface-card, surface-page, surface-sunken (light, brand-cyan-700, 5:1+) and on every dark surface (brand-cyan).

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and surface-inverse-alt.

tokens.name: text-on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse and surface-inverse-alt.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on action-primary (navy) and on the filter Tag. Dark theme reverses it.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px borders on surface-card and surface-page: decoration, not meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline button and tag borders, strong dividers on surface-card. Not for form controls: use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, switch (3:1 kept as in the DS).

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Active navigation line (2 px).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, one per view (reference navy). Dark theme inverts it to paper.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the primary button (reference).

tokens.name: action-primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button.

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Navy marks: selected Tag, current page, navy Badge. Not the secondary button, which is a white surface.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline (3:1 or more on paper and card).

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus outline on navy surfaces.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on surface-page and surface-card. Underline on hover.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover on surface-page and surface-card, with a 3px offset underline.

tokens.name: link-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Links on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success fill and marks. Pair with an icon or word. As text use status-success-text.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill and marks. Pair with an icon or word. As text use status-warning-text.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Danger fill, error borders and marks. Pair with an icon or word. As text use status-danger-text.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational marks.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on surface-card, surface-page and the success tint. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface-card, surface-page and the warning tint. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: status-danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text on surface-card, surface-page and the danger tint. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Ink, the main text colour of the reference.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Teal of the reference. Progress fills and decorative marks. Never text on a light surface.

tokens.name: accent-teal-strong
tokens.usage: Teal for text, icons, active navigation line and focus ring (4.5:1 on paper). Dark theme uses the light teal.

tokens.name: accent-teal-subtle
tokens.usage: Active state background (aula, selected step).

tokens.name: text-on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on the teal button variant.

tokens.name: border-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Border of the accent badge.

styles.name: eyebrow
